units.lyric_anchor: 手牽手 一步兩步三步四步 望著天 (95.58-101.36)
units.note: Numbers-metre beat: the counting rhythm IS the shot, so the frame holds and the feet do the moving. Anchor = SHOTLIST v3 S3-17, frame = the C2145 re-roll that replaced the failed full-body two-shot.
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Locked-off low close-up on two pairs of feet. Two pairs of feet step along the faded white centre line in a counting rhythm, four shoes landing one after another, dusk dust lifting at each contact, the white paint bright underfoot. The camera stays still on the ground and lets the stepping carry the frame. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the warm dusk telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.lyric_anchor: 一片雲 掉落在我面前 (38.52-43.22)
units.note: Wind-through-fabric beat under the falling-cloud lyric. Handlebar is the true contact point per the Chinese shot cell (the English cell was corrected in C2145).
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Tight side close-up held on a steady frame. Her hands grip the bicycle handlebar, the knuckles flexing once as the front wheel finds a rut, the loose school shirt billowing and snapping in the warm wind, grass blades streaking past at the frame edge. Her face sits outside the crop. The camera holds with a very small drift at a slightly quickened pace. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the warm 2001 telecine palette. LIT_BY_NOON. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.lyric_anchor: 看遠方的星 如果聽得見 (133.31-138.00)
units.note: Look-up beat played as observable sequence (mouth corner first, then eyes) instead of an emotion word. Long window so the half beat is not rushed.
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Steady medium close-up. She lowers her head for a half beat, the corner of her mouth lifting first, then she raises her eyes to him and holds them there. Warm dusk backlight rims her hair and the edge of her cheek, the near eye catching one small highlight. The camera holds with a very small drift, letting the half-beat land. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the 2001 telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.lyric_anchor: 看星星 一顆兩顆三顆四顆 連成線 (209.36-214.68)
units.note: Line-closing hand hold (the motif that opened at S0-03). Longest B window; slowest speed so the hand contact reads before the cut to the final sky card.
units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Steady close two-shot under the night sky. The two of them turn to face each other, her hand finding his, the thumbs pressing once before both hold, the shoulders settling a notch. Cool starlight falls on warm skin while a faint lamp edge warms the near cheek. The camera holds with a small drift, letting the pair breathe in one slow take. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the 2001 telecine palette. LIT_BY_NIGHT. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Locked-off medium close-up. Her fingertips hover a half beat above the wooden kite spool, then take the line and wind it two slow turns against the pull of the wind, her gaze fixed past the frame edge. Dusk backlight rims her forearm and the taut line. The camera stays still and lets the winding carry the movement. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the warm dusk telecine palette. LIT_BY_DUSK. 35mm film grain, telecine texture, 2001 Taiwan music video look

units.i2v_prompt: Taiwan countryside around the Taitung-Danshui hills, 2000 era, faded single centre line road, golden grass fields, a small tin-and-brick farmhouse. Locked-off close-up at shoulder height. She stands with her back to the lens and folds her arm across, her fingers hooking the hem of his jacket so the fabric creases over her wrist. His eyes lower toward her hand, then lift to her face, both heads at the same height. The camera stays still and holds the two of them. Preserve the 35mm film grain and the 2001 telecine palette.
